e: Postdoc in the Particle Physics and Cosmology Theory Group (Maleknejad, Tasinato, Zavala) on how gravitational-wave experiments probe early-Universe physics and the dark sector; the group is active in LISA, NANOGrav and Euclid. Open to PhDs in theoretical cosmology or GW physics.
n: Swansea University: Postdoctoral Research Associate in Gravitational Wave Cosmology
